msContents.summary: A paper manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya.

lg.l:
kathayaṃta hi tīrthānāṃ prabhāvā
n adbhutān muni ||
lomaśaṃ dharmmatatvajñaṃ paryyapṛchad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||

|| yo rakṣet prāṇinaṃ vrahman_ bhayāttaṃ
śaraṇāgataṃ ||
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat syāt tan me vrūhi mahāmune ||

|| ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarvve samagravarada
kṣiṇāḥ |
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ ||
idam eva purā devā | svatulayā samatolayan ||

prāṇirakṣaṇa
vaim eveha gauraveṇātiḥricyate ||
|| atraivodāharaṃtīmam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ ||
iṃdrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śiver auśīnarasya ca ||
varttamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārthaṃ śiviṃ nṛpaṃ ||
iṃdraḥ śyenaḥ kapoto gnir bhūtvā tatropajagmatuḥ ||

|| athāṃkaṃ nṛpateḥ prā
pya kapotaḥ śyenajād bhayāt ||
śaraṇārthā mahīpāla nililye bhayavihvalaḥ |
tataḥ śanair upāgamya syenarūpī sureśvaraḥ |
rājānaṃ sa mahātmānaṃ provācedaṃ vacas tadā ||
|| dharmmātmānaṃ tvām ihāhur ekaṃ rājan mahīkṣita ||

sa
tvaṃ dharmmaviruddhaṃ hi kathaṃ karmma cikīrṣasi ||
bhavān_ kṛtaghnaṃ dānena satyenānṛtavādinaṃ ||

kṣamayā krūrakarmāṇam asā
dhuṃ sādhunā jayat ||
nāpakārāparo py evam upakāraparo yathā ||
ahite hitabuddhis tvaṃ pāpe pi tvam apāpakṛt ||

do
ṣānveṣaṇadakṣe pi guṇānveṣaṇatatparaḥ ||
tad eṣa vihito bhakṣyaḥ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā ||

mā hiṃsair lobhato dharmmam e
nam utsṛja bhūpate ||
saṃtrastarūpas trāṇārthī tvatto bhīto dharmmam enam utsṛja bhūpate ||

||
saṃtrastarūpas trāṇārthī tvato bhīto vihaṃgamaḥ |
matsakāśam anuprāptaḥ prāṇa gṛdhnur ayaṃ khagaḥ |

tad eva gatasyāsya kapo
tasya bhayāt tava ||
katham asmadvidhaḥ kuryāt tyāgaṃ sadbhir vigarhitaṃ ||
lobhād veṣād bhayād vāpi yas tyajecharaṇāgataṃ ||

vra
hmahatyāsamaṃ tasya pāpam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ |
śāstreṣu niḥkṛtir ddṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām api ||

śaraṇāgatahaṃtṛṇāṃ na śrutā
niḥkṛtir mayā ||
yathātmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇāḥ sarvveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā ||
tasmān mṛtyubhayātrastātavyāḥ prāṇino vudhaiḥ |
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhair nityaṃ sāṃsārasāgare ||
jaṃtavaḥ parikliśyaṃte mṛtyos trasyaṃti te dhikaṃ ||

yannimittaṃ bhavechokas trā
so vā krodha eva ca ||
āyāso vā yato mūlam ekāham api tat tyajet ||
mariṣyāmīti ya duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate ||

yu
ktaṃ tenānumānena paro pi parirakṣituṃ ||
yathā hi te jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyaṃ ||

saṃrakṣa
se jīvitam ātmano tha vā tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitaṃ ||
tasmān nāham imaṃ bhītam arpayiṣye kapotakaṃ ||

yad atra yukta
m anyat syān mama syanāśu tad vadaḥ ||
|| āhārāt sarvvabhūtāni saṃbhavaṃti janeśvara ||

āhāreṇa vivarddhate
tena jīvati jaṃtavaḥ ||
śakyate nyair vinā py arthai rājan_ varttayituṃ ciraṃ ||
na tv āhāravihīnena śakyaṃ varttayituṃ ciraṃ ||

bhakṣya
d vilopitasyāsmān mama prāṇā viśāṃ pate |
vihāya kāyaṃ yāsyaṃti paṃthānam apunarbhavāṃ ||

mṛte ca mayi sarvvaṃ me putradā
raṃ mariṣyati ||
rakṣamāṇaḥ kapotaṃ tvaṃ vahūn prāṇān_ haniṣyasi ||
dharmo yo vādhate dharmmeam anyaṃ sa na mataḥ satāṃ ||

aviro
dhī tu yo dharmmaḥ sa dharmaḥ sadbhir ucyate ||
tasmād virodhe dharmasya saṃciṃtya gurulāghavaṃ ||

yachreyas tan mahīpāla kuru dharmma
vinirṇṇayaṃ ||
bahukalyāṇasaṃyuktaṃ bhāṣase vihagottama ||

suparṇṇaḥ pakṣirāḍ tvaṃ hi dharma eva na saṃśa
yaḥ ||
yathā hi dharmmasayuktaṃ vahuvitraṃ prabhāṣase ||
na te sty aviditaṃ kiṃcid iti tvāṃ lakṣayāmy ahaṃ ||

nāto bhūyastaro
dharmmaḥ kaścid anyo 'sti khecara ||
prāṇināṃ bhayasītānām abhayaṃ yat pradīyate ||

varam ekasya satvasya pradattābhayada
kṣiṇā ||
na tu viprasahasrasya gosahasram alaṃkṛtaṃ ||
abhayaṃ sarvvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ ||

tasya dehād vimuktasya
na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit ||
hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi ||
durlabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvvabhūtadayāpradaḥ |
mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalaṃ ||
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate |

dattam iṣṭaṃ tapas taptaṃ tīrtha
sevā śrutaṃ tathā ||
sarvvāṇy abhayadānasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīṃ ||
catuḥsāgaraparyaṃtāṃ yo dadyā||t pṛthivīm imāṃ ||
abhayaṃ yaś ca bhūtebhyas tayobhar abhayado dhikaḥ ||
api tyaje rājyam idaṃ śarīraṃ vā sudustyajaṃ ||

na tv imaṃ bhayasaṃtra
staṃ tyakṣye dīnaṃ kapotakaṃ ||
yan mamāsti śubhaṃ kiṃcit tena janmani janmani janmani ||

bhaveyam aham ārtthānāṃ praṇinā
m ārtināśakaḥ ||
na hy ahaṃ kāmaye rājyaṃ na svargaṃ nāpunarbhavaṃ ||
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānāṃ kāmaye bhayanāśanaṃ ||

yathā ca nā
nṛtā vāṇī mayaiṣā samudāhṛtā ||
satyenānena bhagavān_ prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ ||

āhārārthe samāraṃbha sava cāpi
vihaṃgama ||
tadāśreṣṭaṃ tavāhāram anyaṃm eva dadāmi te ||

sa eva vihito smākaṃ dhātrā bhakyaḥ kapo
takaḥ ||
tam evotsṛjya nāhāraiḥ kāryam āsty aparair mama ||
syanāḥ kapotān_ khādaṃti śrutir eṣā sanātanī ||

mā rājan_
sāram ajñātvā kadalīskaṃdham āruha ||
nāhaṃ uchāstramārgeṇa kvacid vartte vihaṃgama ||

śāstrair evopa
diṣṭo yaṃ dharmmaḥ satvadayāparaḥ ||
sarvvasatveṣu yad dānam ekasatve ca yā dayā ||

sarvvasatvapradānāt tu dayaikāsmād viśi
ṣyeate ||
sarvve vedā na tat kuryuḥ sarvve yajñāś ca khecara ||
sarvvatīrthābhiṣekaś ca yat kuryāt prāṇināṃ dayā ||

vāgmanaḥkarma
bhir ye tu sarvvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||
dayādāarśitayaṃthāno vrahmaloka vrajaṃti te ||

gacchatas tiṣuṣṭato vāpi jāgrataḥ sva
pato pi vā ||
yan na bhūtahitārthāya tat paśor iva ceṣṭhitaṃ ||
jaṃgamāni ca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ ||

ātmavatpa¦
rirakṣaṃti te yāṃti paramāṃ gatiṃ ||
prāṇināṃ vadhyamānānāṃ yaḥ śaktaḥ samupekṣate ||

sa yāti narakaiaṃ ghore iti prāhur manī
nīṣiṇaḥ ||
rājyaṃ śivīnāṃ sumahat prayachāmi tava dvija ||
yad vā kāmayase hy anyad varjayitvā kapotakaṃ ||
yadi rājan kapote sudṛḍhā prītir īdṛśī ||
tataḥ kapotātulyāni svamāṃsāni prayacha mai ||

||
anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ syanābhibhāṣase ||
etat te haṃ prayachāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāvad iktasi ||
yad apriyaṃ tat sujanāaś cirāid vadati vānavaṃ ||
mamātipriyam evaitat kasmād abhihitaṃ cirāt ||

adhruvaieṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavinā
śinā ||
dhruvaṃ yo nārjeyed dharmmaṃ sa śocyo mūḍhacetanaḥ ||
yadi prāṇyupakārāya deho yaṃ nopayujyate ||

tataḥ kim upa
cāro sya pratyahaṃ kriyate vṛthā ||
|| nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce tavā māṃsaṃ janeśvarā ||

tasmāt kapote
nādhṛtaṃ prayacha tulayā samaṃ ||
tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ syenābhiyācase ||

yenāsya rakṣaṇam me syā
raḳṣaṇaṃ me syāt tadvat tava vihaṃgama ||
|| evam uktvā svamāṃsāni samutkṛtya sa pārthivaḥ ||

prahṛṣṭas to
layāmāsa kapotena sahā prabhuḥ ||
tyaktvātmasukhabhogechāḥ sarvvasatvasukhaiṣiṇaḥ ||

bhavaṃti paraduḥkhena sādhavo
nityaduḥkhitāḥ ||
dhriyamāṇas tu tulayā kapoto vyātiricyate ||
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni tataḥ prādān mahīpatiḥ ||
na vidyate yada māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit
tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso sāv āruroha tulāṃ svayaṃ ||

paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ sarvvabhūtahite
ratāḥ ||
nopekṣaṃte mahātmanaḥ svasukhāni mahāṃty api ||
atha tasmin samārūḍhe tulām auśīnare nṛpe ||

devaduṃdubhayo ne
duḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta
dā matvā devarājo dhṛtiṃ parāṃ ||
śākraḥ svarūpam āsthāya vākyam etad abhāṣatā ||

||
iṃdro ham asmi bhadraṃ te kapoto havyavāṭ_ svayaṃ |
jijñāsamānau tvāṃ rājann imaṃ yajñam upāgatau ||

naitat pūrvvaṃ nṛpāś cakrur nna kari
ṣyaṃti cāpare ||
mahākāruṇikeneha yat kṛtaṃ duḥkaraṃ nṛpa ||
parārthe tyajataḥ prāṇānyā prītir abhavat tava ||

prāṇasaṃśayalu
bdheṣu na sya prāṇeṣu dehināṃ ||
parārthaikāṃtakalyāṇī svāśreyātyaṃtaniṣṭhurā |

tvayy eva kevalā rājan_ karuṇī karuṇā
yate ||
prāyaśaḥ sudṛḍhair vaddhaṃ tathā kṛtsnām idaṃ jagat ||
tvaṃ jagaduḥkhamokṣārthaṃ vaddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpa ||

tathā sarvvātmanā vā
pi doṣeṣv apahṛtaṃ tvayā ||
yathā caivātmanaḥ sthāne vāsanāpi na vidyate ||
akṛtverṣyāṃ ca vṛddheṣu hīnān anavamanya ca ||

akṛtvā
sadṛśe sparddhāṃ tvaṃ lokottamatāṃ gataḥ ||
ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇān_ yo naraḥ parirakṣati ||

sa yāti paramaṃ dhāma yato nāmachite pu
naḥ ||
prāṇair api tvayā rājan_ rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇo janaḥ |
svamāṃsāny api dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā ||

paśavo pi hi jīvaṃti ke
valātmodaraṃbharāḥ ||
pusasa punar jīvitaḥ ślāghyo yaḥ parārthāya jīvati |
kim atra citraṃ yat saṃtaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ ||

na
hi svadehaśītāya jāyaṃte candanadrumāḥ ||
paropakāravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā ||

sa tatpadam avāpnoti parād a
pi hi yat paraṃ ||
paropakāraikadhiyaḥ svasukhāya gataspṛhāḥ |
jagadditāya jāyaṃte sādhavas tv ādṛśī bhuvi ||

yat sva
māṃsāni bhūtebhyaḥ samutkṛttāni pārthiva ||
eṣā te śāśvatī kīrttir lokān anugāmiṣyati ||

||
evam uktvā tu iṃdrāgnī jagmatus tridaśālayaṃ ||
rājā tu kratum iṣṭvā sa mumude devavac ciraṃ ||

ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śive
ś caritam uttamaṃ ||
sa vidhūyeha pāpāni prayāti tridivaṃ naraḥ ||

viciṃtya rājyasvaśarīram adhruvaṃ dhruvaṃ yaśaḥ sarvvajana
sya durlajanasyadurlabhaṃ ||
śarīradānāt parajīvarakṣaṇaṃ | vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau ||

body.p:
|| iti śrī itihāsasamu
ccaye śivīdrāgnisaṃvādo nāma caturtho dhyāyaḥ ||
